Preliminary targeting guide:
- Gaming nerd. Fan of all genres, even crappy games, and all systems, even the 32X. She's good at them too. (Except she's bad at dating sims, which she's insecure about.)
- Member of the same school as Kyoko and Chihiro, member of the same class as Mikan and Mahiru.
- Personality: dopey on the outside, really intelligent and insightful on the inside, extraordinarily kindhearted even though she often expresses this in a pretty hyperfixated way. May or may not have that autistic rizz.
- Eepy girl. Straight-up narcoleptic (hilarious) up in here, sometimes just falls asleep standing up for a little bit (pose for this coming soon™️).
